description: GraveGain5D: a dark fantasy RPG across six parallel Arroyos — Prime, Echo, Dream, Void, Bloom, and Static. Pick your race and class, delve dungeon floors, and hop universes to outflank the undead Array. Sworn to the Compact of Shared Blood, you defend MoonRock's sixfold colony while Hades collects every collapsed spare. Vent paradox, beat the collapse timers, and bring the Arroyos home.
instructions: Choose your race and class, then delve dungeon combat across 6 parallel Arroyos: Prime, Echo, Dream, Void, Bloom, and Static. Attack with click or Space, spend your race and class Ability with F, Hop universes with U to dodge danger and line up combos, drink a Potion with 1 when hurt, or Wait with 2 to steady yourself. Every hop builds paradox — vent it with calm turns and hop combos before hot universes start their collapse timers. If a timer runs out, that Arroyo falls to Hades — finish your delve before the lattice closes.

maker.bio: One dimension walked, two crawled, three delved, four folded — five transcends.
